---
title: "classnote"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
sigma_dist <- map_dbl(1:1000, function(i) {
  sample <- rnorm(200, mean = 100, sd =20)
  sd(sample)
})
```

```{r}
sigma_dist <- map_dbl(1:1000, \(i) { #syntactic sugar
  sample <- rnorm(200, mean = 100, sd =20)
  sd(sample)})

```

```{r}
ggplot(tibble(sigma_hat = sigma_dist), aes(sigma_hat)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
# quantile vs qnorm
x <- rnorm(1000, 0, 1)
quantile(x , c(0.025, 0.975))
qnorm(c(o.o25, 0.975), 0, 1)

ggplot() +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) dnorm(x, 0, 1)) +
  
```
